scientific_integrity: Analytic spectral and strict-concavity proof of the stated unrestricted optimum; finite exact and randomized experiments are corroboration, not proof. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-budget classification is for equal-size bipartite sides, one uniform price for a designated perfect matching, one uniform price for other edges, and freely chosen nonnegative continuous conductances. The matching-containment enumeration and crown-graph resistance identities are prior results, not claimed as novel; possible independently published equivalent design rules remain an originality risk.
title: Price-threshold deletion of a perfect matching in determinant-optimal bipartite networks
